info.title: Internbot API
info.description: Backend workflow API for the Internbot internship platform. Source of truth: [WORKFLOW-API-SPEC.md](https://github.com/giatinhuynh/Internbot/blob/develop/docs/WORKFLOW-API-SPEC.md).

get.description: Public, unauthenticated. Returns 200 when the backend is serving requests.

get.summary: Return the caller's own platform user record
get.description: Resolves to the caller's platform user. The auth middleware hydrates identity from Firestore and JIT-creates the record on first call from a verified RMIT student email. Returns 403 `no_platform_user` when JIT cannot run (unverified email, non-student-shape email, or unprovisioned coordinator). See WORKFLOW-API-SPEC.md §7.2.

401.description: Missing or invalid Firebase ID token (or caller has not yet synced).

patch.summary: Update the caller's own student profile
patch.description: Resolves to the caller's platform user from the decoded token's `platformUserId` claim. Student-only. Top-level identity fields (`email`, `role`, `firebaseUid`, `status`, `onboardingStage`) are not writable. `profileStatus` is derived server-side. `studentProfile.studentNumber` is immutable after first sync. See WORKFLOW-API-SPEC.md §7.2.

put.summary: Enrol the caller in a semester
put.description: Resolves to the caller's platform user. Student-only. The semester must be `active` and within its enrolment window. `semesterSelectedAt` is set on the first successful selection only. See WORKFLOW-API-SPEC.md §7.6.

displayName.description: The student-facing display name. Self-settable after sign-up (registration no longer captures a name). Trimmed; 1–100 chars.

PatchUserRequest.description: Body for PATCH /api/v1/users/:id. `displayName` and `studentProfile` are both writable and optional (send either or both). Other top-level identity fields (email, role, firebaseUid, status, onboardingStage) are rejected with 400.

studentNumber.description: Same value as first-sync is a no-op; a different value returns 400 `immutable_field`.

academicInfo.description: Replace the academic info block, or `null` to clear it (returns the profile to incomplete).

completedCourses.description: Self-attested completed course codes (e.g. internship prerequisites). Not verified against an academic record.

semesterId.description: The active semester to enrol in (see WORKFLOW-API-SPEC.md §7.6).

CreateSemesterRequest.description: Body for POST /api/v1/semesters. Coordinator-only. See WORKFLOW-API-SPEC.md §7.5.

PatchSemesterRequest.description: Body for PATCH /api/v1/semesters/:id. Immutable fields (`id`, `semesterCode`, `courseCode`, `status`) are rejected with 400. Use POST /api/v1/semesters/:id/transitions for status changes. See WORKFLOW-API-SPEC.md §7.5.

CreateOpportunityRequest.description: Body for POST /api/v1/opportunities. Coordinator and student callers have different server-side defaults. See WORKFLOW-API-SPEC.md §7.3.

PatchOpportunityRequest.description: Body for PATCH /api/v1/opportunities/:id. Lifecycle fields are rejected with 400. See WORKFLOW-API-SPEC.md §7.3.

CreateOpportunityAttachmentUploadIntentR.description: Body for POST /api/v1/opportunities/:id/attachments/upload-intents. Returns a signed PUT URL the coordinator uploads the file bytes to directly.

PatchInternshipRequest.description: Body for PATCH /api/v1/internships/:id. Lifecycle and ownership fields are rejected with 400.

CreateInternshipAttachmentUploadIntentRe.description: Body for POST /api/v1/internships/:id/attachments/upload-intents. Returns a signed PUT URL the student-owner uploads the file bytes to directly.

SubmitInternshipOfferRequest.description: Body for POST /api/v1/internships/:id/offer-submissions. All fields are optional — submission only requires at least one finalized offer attachment. Dates may be supplied later by the coordinator.

read.description: Must be true. Resetting notifications to unread is not supported in v1.

UserResponse.description: Polymorphic user record — shape depends on `role`.

StudentUserResponse.description: User record for role=student. Includes studentProfile and workflow step.

CurrentWorkflowStep.description: Coarse routing-level workflow step derived from the student's profile and internship state (see WORKFLOW-API-SPEC.md §7.1).

StudentProfileResponse.description: Embedded student profile on a User response (see §8.2A).

completedCourses.description: Self-attested completed course codes. Always present (empty array when none recorded).

yearLevel.description: Derived current year level from creditUnitsEarned on a 96-CP/year load, clamped to [1, 4]. Not persisted.

confirmedAt.description: Set once at first profile-complete transition; not rewritten on subsequent edits.

AcademicInfoResponse.description: Confirmed academic information on a student profile (see §8.2B).

CoordinatorUserResponse.description: User record for role=coordinator. Identity fields only, no studentProfile.

ErrorResponse.description: RFC 9457 Problem Details wrapped with the domain error envelope — see docs/ERROR-HANDLING.md.

code.description: Coarse machine-readable code aligned to HTTP status class.

reason.description: Fine-grained sub-code for client UX branching (see WORKFLOW-API-SPEC.md §7.0).

UserWorkflowResponse.description: Body of GET /api/v1/users/{id}/workflow. All three fields are derived (none are persisted).

InternshipStatus.description: Fine derived workflow state for display (see WORKFLOW-API-SPEC.md §9.2).

SemesterEnrolmentState.description: Derived display state for the semester enrolment step (see WORKFLOW-API-SPEC.md §7.2).

UserActivityFeedResponse.description: Paginated activity feed for the caller.

UserActivityFeedItemResponse.description: One activity-feed entry authored by the caller.

uploadStatus.description: Lifecycle state. `uploading` = intent issued, signed URL outstanding, GCS object not confirmed yet. `finalized` = OBJECT_FINALIZE event observed, file is downloadable.

bearerAuth.description: Firebase ID token obtained client-side. Platform identity is hydrated at the api edge from `userIdentities/{provider}__{uid}` → `users/{id}` on every request; on a brand-new student-shape email the hydrator JIT-creates the platform record in the same transaction. See docs/WORKFLOW-API-SPEC.md §7.0.
